notes_for_editor: The three sources agree on build year, last staffing and the 2000 fire. Idaho Fire Lookouts uses the word burned, Forest Lookouts uses destroyed; the story reports both as a loss to fire. No source describes the site today, so the today section is a gap. The Forest Lookouts page quotes a 1961 National Geodetic Survey station recovery on the summit; it does not say whether any marker survives, so it is not used.
